title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Trio #30 (SpanishAndalusian+SpanishTalaveraReina / PolishBoleslawiec+FilipinoYakan / JapaneseMakie+PortugueseAzulejo)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Indian woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, kohl-lined almond eyes, a small gold bindi, a deep maroon-red lip, warm golden-brown skin, cheerful, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in curly, real living eyes. Long square nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her LEFT side is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her RIGHT side is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following every crease, dense floral medallion border filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Left woman's footwear: extreme ballet heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a bright, giddy grin, cheerful, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes. Long square nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her upper body, from her collarbones down to her waistline, is painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs), wide white bands following every deep crease, dense peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her lower body, from her waistline down to her ankles, is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following every crease, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto corset-lace boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Ukrainian woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, cool and composed, cool ash-brown hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her LEFT side is painted in Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder), wide gold-powder bands following every deep crease, dense gold powder glittering densely filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her RIGHT side is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), wide cobalt bands following every crease, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform clear heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
